name: @pipeworx/mcp-us-code

tools.name: usc_section
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the United States Code — federal statutes — by citation. "18 U.S.C. 1343" is title 18, section 1343. Returns the statutory text, its title and chapter, and the edition it came from. Keyless. Use for "what does the wire fraud statute say", "what is the text of 42 USC 1983", or to check what a statute a case relies on actually provides.

title.description: US Code title number, 1-54. E.g. "18" for crimes, "26" for tax, "42" for public health and welfare.

section.description: Section number as cited, e.g. "1343" or "1983". Subsections like "1343(a)" are not separate documents — pass the section.

tools.name: usc_titles
tools.description: List the 54 titles of the United States Code with their subject names — title 18 is Crimes and Criminal Procedure, title 26 is the Internal Revenue Code, and so on. Keyless. Use when you know the subject area but not which title governs it, before calling usc_section.

tools.name: usc_search
tools.description: Search the United States Code by subject to find which statutes are relevant — "wire fraud", "endangered species take". Returns matching section headings and their titles; call usc_section for the text. Needs a data.gov API key, which Pipeworx fronts; pass _apiKey to use your own. For a citation you already have, usc_section is keyless and more direct.

query.description: Subject matter, e.g. "wire fraud" or "clean water discharge permit".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-us-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the us-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
